name: @lattice/demo
description: LAMP ROAD — the first gallery exhibit. A valley at dusk, and the proof that the seams fit.
$comment: Seven of nine, and the two that are missing are a finding rather than an oversight. This exhibit has no save, so it needs no @lattice/persist, and it draws its one line of HUD into the canvas, so it needs no @lattice/ui. Both were declared here while the demo was still the game in docs/rfc/demo.md; see that document's orphan ledger for what depends on them now.
